# axiz-secrets-spring-boot-autoconfigure

SecretResolver over mounted files, environment and AWS Secrets Manager / Parameter Store (auto-configuration).

## Dependency

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>pe.axiz</groupId>
  <artifactId>axiz-secrets-spring-boot-autoconfigure</artifactId>
</dependency>
```

The version is managed by `axiz-bom` (services inherit `axiz-parent-service`).

## Main types

| Type | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `AxizSecretsAutoConfiguration` | `SecretResolver` over mounted files, environment variables and the AWS adapters, with a TTL cache. |
| `AxizSecretsAwsAutoConfiguration` | AWS Secrets Manager and Parameter Store sources, each enabled explicitly. |
| `AxizSecretsProperties` | Secret resolution (`axiz.secrets.*`). |
| `SecretSource` | A secret source contributed by an adapter; sources are queried in bean order after mounted files and the environment. |
| `SecretsConfigTreeEnvironmentPostProcessor` | Imports the mounted secret files as a config tree (`optional:configtree:`), so a file named `spring.datasource.password` becomes that property. |

## Tests

Unit tests live in `src/test/java` and document the expected behavior; run them with `./mvnw -pl spring/axiz-secrets-spring-boot-autoconfigure verify`.
